QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Yuris the Mechanic Elf
QuestInfo.1: Yuris asked you to get back her lost #bFloating Rock Fragment#k. It resembles an orange gem. Find it in the #bSmall Forest#k.
QuestInfo.2: As soon as you presented the Floating Rock Fragment, Yuris rejoiced that the airship will be soon repaired.

item.0: Huh? You didn't find it? The #bFloating Rock Fragment#k should be in the #bSmall Forest#k. Search every inch of the forest.
